settings.refresh-to-use-the: Refresh to use the latest features; practice and exam progress is saved automatically.
settings.add-targets-like-exam: Add targets like exam date or license expiry on the countdown page; the browser notifies when they expire.
settings.enter-the-issue-date: Enter the issue date to auto-calculate the expiry (5-year validity) and add a countdown reminder (apply for renewal well before expiry).
settings.export-all-local-data: Export all local data (progress, mistakes, bookmarks, logbook, etc.) as JSON; restore on another device, or merge data from multiple devices.
settings.added-to-countdown-the: Added to countdown; the browser will notify you when it expires.
settings.this-browser-doesn-t: This browser doesn't support Web Push.
settings.alerts-only-fire-while: Alerts only fire while a page is open; if denied, re-enable in browser settings.
settings.favorite-satellites-and-lead: Favorite satellites and lead time are set on the satellites page.
settings.receive-daily-study-reminders: Receive daily study reminders even when the page is closed (sent by the backend push service).
settings.time-to-study-today: Time to study! Today's prep tasks are waiting.
settings.manage-browser-notification-per: Manage browser notification permission and alert toggles
